Anita L: Quick sanity run for seahawk embeddings on the 10k holdout — ran the default pipeline with no quant. Recall@10 is down ~1.8% vs baseline (opal-v1). Dropping raw notes and logs below.

Jordan: can you paste the exact command you used?

Anita L: ```./eval/run_holdout.sh --model seahawk --holdout 10k --metric recall@10 --batch 256 --normalize false```

Ryan: baseline numbers?

Anita L: opal-v1 recall@10 = 0.842, seahawk = 0.824. MRR also down ~0.02. Cosine pairwise histogram shifted left; UMAP shows clusters tighter but some Q->A nearest neighbors are wrong for short queries.

Sophia: did you try the quantized/artifact build (int8) or the FP32 export?

Anita L: ran int8 too — int8 cut another ~1.2% off recall (so ~3% total vs opal). Interestingly long queries (>50 tokens) improved slightly on seahawk.

Jordan: any quick hypotheses? different norm scale, missing postnorm step in export, or embedding dim mismatch?

Anita L: looks like post-export normalization was not applied in the packaged artifact. Raw L2 norms have higher variance (mean/ std off). I added an on-the-fly L2 normalize and reran: recall@10 jumped to 0.838 (almost beat opal). So likely export step bug.

Ryan: great catch. Can we codify a check in onboarding to catch norm drift?

Sophia: yes — add checks for embedding_l2_mean, embedding_l2_std, and a quick KL divergence against baseline cosine distribution. If either is outside threshold, fail the onboarding smoke.

Jordan: also add a tiny sample verification: pick 50 short queries and ensure recall@5 >= X (tunable).

eval-bot: Added checks to the onboarding pipeline: "embedding_l2_mean", "embedding_l2_std", and "cosine_pairwise_kld" thresholds. Failing runs will block staging rollout and send alert to #eng-ml.

Anita L: PR with the fix + tests: https://git.redwood/seahawk/changes/234 (includes export fix and a normalize hook).

Jordan: can you paste top 10 failure examples so product can inspect relevance drift?

Anita L: mini CSV of top failures (query,expected):
```
short: where is GDPR info?, docs -> privacy/gdpr
short: password reset not working?, support -> password-reset
phrase: best way to deploy redwood?, docs -> deploy/overview
name-only: api key rotation?, security -> keys
short: pricing page link?, billing -> pricing
short: how to set up VPC?, docs -> private/vpc
short: rate limit per token?, docs -> limits
short: which models support streaming?, docs -> api/streaming
short: can I use on-prem?, sales -> on-prem options
short: embeddings dimension?, docs -> embeddings/faq
```

ops-oncall: :thumbsup: pausing scheduled seahawk canary until next green.

Sophia: let's do a 30min triage tomorrow 10am PT — I'll bring the norm histograms and UMAP snapshots.

Anita L: thanks everyone — will follow up with a cleaned run and updated artifact by EOD.

Jordan: thanks, @Anita L :rocket:
